_comment: Achievements, in display order. Evaluated by scripts/systems/achievements.gd on every machine (host and co-op guests) from replicated game state, and unlocked into this PC's profile (user://achievements.json). Steam API names are ACH_<ID IN CAPITALS> (Achievements.steam_name). Conditions: stat (totals.* / lifetime.* / day.* / reputation / cash), day_stat, summary + day_end (end-of-day summary), building (premises tier reached), fixture / fixture_count (types may name a fixture_sets entry), goal (+within_days, campaign milestones in goals.json), skill_level (the local player), players (in the session now), event (counted on this PC), flag (character settings), achievements (every other one), all / any. Comparators: gte, lte, gt, lt, eq (default: >= 1).
